summary: Supervisors rejected Vermaland's 3,300-acre project near Eloy, reported as what would have been Arizona's largest data center campus.
notes: Pinal County's zoning code is reported to contain no definitions or development requirements for data centers. A denial in a jurisdiction with no data center provisions is a different fact pattern from a denial under an adopted standard.
